meta.dataset: Indicative available soil water capacity by texture
meta.units: mm water per m soil depth
meta.source: FAO Soil and Water, Chapter 2, Table 8 (adapted from Salter and Williams 1967)
meta.notes: Values are typical and vary with soil structure and management. They are not a substitute for a local soil test; These Table 8 capacities are context only. Estimated mode uses the separate FAO-56 Table 19 volumetric texture ranges when an exact texture is available.

fao56TypicalValues.source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Chapter 7, Table 19
fao56TypicalValues.verificationStatus: FAO56_PUBLISHED_RANGES; defaults are arithmetic midpoints of published ranges, not field measurements
fao56TypicalValues.notes: Typical values are the midpoints of FAO-56 volumetric ranges. Soil choices without published volumetric ranges require field measurements. Table 8 available water capacity is context only.
